claim.claim-text: a compressible valve body (100C) having a retaining flange (140) and a head, the retaining flange (140) forming a bottom surface of the compressible valve body (100C), and the head forming a continuous top surface (120) of the compressible valve body (100C), and the head comprising a compression feature (132C) forming an asymmetrical cavity that extends from the bottom surface up toward the top surface (120); and a housing (210), wherein the valve body (100C) is positioned within the housing for controlling a fluid flow through the needleless valve assembly.
2. The needleless valve assembly of Claim 1, wherein the continuous top surface (120) is non-planar during the fluid flow through the needleless valve assembly.

3. The needleless valve assembly of Claim 1, wherein the continuous top surface (120) is tilted (320) relative to a top surface of the housing during the fluid flow through the needleless valve assembly.
4. The needleless valve assembly of Claim 1, wherein the continuous top surface (120) is deformed in a V-shape (420) during the fluid flow through the needleless valve assembly.
5. The needleless valve assembly of Claim 1, wherein the continuous top surface (120) does not require a slit.
6. The needleless valve assembly of Claim 1, wherein the compression feature (132C) is asymmetric along a center cross-section of the compressible valve body (100C).
7. The needleless valve assembly of Claim 1, wherein the compression feature (132C) is off-set along a center cross-section of the compressible valve body (100C).

8. A compressible valve body (100C) for controlling a fluid flow through a compressible needleless valve assembly, the valve body (100C) comprising a retaining flange (140) and a head, the retaining flange (140) forming a bottom surface of the compressible valve body (100C), and the head forming a continuous top surface (120) of the compressible valve body (100C), and the head comprising a compression feature (132C) forming an asymmetrical cavity that extends from the bottom surface up toward the top surface (120).
9. The compressible valve body of Claim 8, wherein the continuous top surface (120) is non-planar when the valve body is uncompressed.
10. The compressible valve body of Claim 8, wherein the continuous top surface (120) is tilted (320) when the head is compressed toward the bottom surface of the compressible valve body (100C).

11. The compressible valve body of Claim 8, wherein the continuous top surface (120) is deformed in a V-shape (420) when the head is compressed toward the bottom surface of the compressible valve body (100C).
12. The compressible valve body of Claim 8, wherein the continuous top surface (120) does not require a slit.
13. The compressible valve body of Claim 8, wherein the compression feature (132C) is asymmetric along a center cross-section of the compressible valve body (100C).
14. The compressible valve body of Claim 8, wherein the compression feature (132C) is off-set along a center cross-section of the compressible valve body (100C).
15. The compressible valve body of Claim 8, wherein a cross-sectional profile of the asymmetrical cavity comprises an amorphous shape.
